method: Current ATT Dragonflight craft/reagent indexes identify candidates. Retail Wowhead item tooltips verify identity and binding; spell tooltips verify reagent quantities and requirements. Public client SpellEffect/CraftingData/quality tables independently verify output IDs and baseline batches. One source recipe per output is recorded. Numeric batch zero for single-object recipes uses the normal one-object creation result, also used by deck assembly. Quality-family item variants share a verified recipe but require skill, reagent quality and specialization; base-quality references do not guarantee higher-quality output. Vendor-only ingredients are omitted from farmable compositions and disclosed in notes. Random milling, prospecting, card and container outcomes have no deterministic named-result recipe.

Check the published Waking Shores pool search areas; enable Find Fish to help detect the special pools.
Prospecting destroys the fish and gives variable results. No fixed fish-to-gem recipe is assigned.

Compare selling the fish with cooking or milling; pigment yields vary.

The reused marker identifies an established creature or coastal search area, not a guaranteed material drop.

specialties.name: Iridescent Plume

tips: Kill and loot Skyfeather Matriarchs and Reservoir Skyfeathers on the two Thaldraszus ledges.
Bluefeather Cliffs harpies and rocs are an alternative. Plumage is a creature drop, not the Windsong Plumage skinning material.

specialties.name: Glowing Titan Orb

Do not rely on old quest-button tricks, historical drop rates or income claims.
Titan-touched gathering is an alternative source, but the recorded farm is the titan-creature grind.

specialties.name: Elusive Croaking Crab
specialties.summary: Saleable Elusive Croaking Crab caught in Forbidden Reach open water or from eligible lunkers; used to summon Sir Pinchalot.
tips: Fish around Dragonskull Island, or check suitable inland open water in the Forbidden Reach.
The Empty Crab Trap consumes the crab to summon Sir Pinchalot; the trap position is a use location, not a guaranteed fishing source.
Catch rates vary, and the crab may also appear from lunker loot.

spots.location: Dragonskull Island and inland fishing waters

specialties.name: Auric Fleece
specialties.summary: Auric Fleece is a saleable skinning result from the bait-summoned Elusive Auric Argali in the Forbidden Reach.
tips: Use the eligible Elusive Creature Bait setup near the Raw Argali Pelts area; the rare is summoned rather than a permanent natural spawn.
Published comments place the interaction around 45.0,36.63, while the bait guide also reports the wider 44.72,40.02 search area.
Summon and skinning cooldown reports vary; the fleece is not guaranteed. It is used for the auric druid-appearance inscription craft.

spots.location: Elusive Auric Argali bait search areas

specialties.name: Zaralek Glowspores
specialties.summary: Auctionable Zaralek Glowspores, including non-ore/herb fishing and skinning sources in Zaralek Cavern.
tips: Fish Luminescent Cave Pools or eligible disturbed water in Zaralek; comments report small Glowspore catches.
Skinning eligible Zaralek creatures is another reported side source. Mining and herbalism are major alternatives, but no new ore/herb routes are added here.
Use as an input for Dracothyst and later profession crafts; small fishing yields are not a guaranteed high-volume substitute.

spots.location: Reported Luminescent Cave Pool search area

specialties.name: Obsidian Cobraskin
specialties.summary: Rare auctionable Obsidian Cobraskin from skinning the Elusive Magma Cobra in Zaralek Cavern.
tips: Use Elusive Creature Bait at the lava pool around 44.05,47.87. Summoning requires Bait Crafter access and 40 points in Mastery.
Treat the first eligible skinning attempt as a daily opportunity; repeated cobras are not an unlimited cobraskin farm. The skin is not guaranteed.
Player reports disagree on reset timing and long-run drop rates. No fixed percentage, current price, or hourly income is assumed.

tips: Use the eligible Elusive Creature Bait setup near 57.24,38.44 in the Emerald Dream; complete the Bait Crafter/Mastery requirements for elusive rare summons.
The antler is a rare result, not a guaranteed reward. Treat elusive rare skinning as a limited opportunity rather than an unlimited mob grind.
Used by Dreamtender's Charm and Verdant Conduit; compare actual market demand before farming.

specialties.name: Dragonpine Lumber
specialties.summary: Dragonpine Lumber is Warband-bound Dragonflight housing timber; finished unused crafted decor is the saleable product.
tips: Harvest supported marked Dragon Isles trees after the housing/lumber introduction.
Tree spawns are dynamic; no permanent lumber-node coordinates are fabricated.
The lumber cannot be auctioned. It appears only as a clearly labeled support input in the housing composition graph.

uncertainty: No live Auction House prices, sale velocity, profit, hourly yield or in-game farming measurements were collected.
Item binding evidence is not a prediction of market demand. Crafted bind-on-equip items are sale products only before use/equipping.
Specialty pins are sourced search areas, not guaranteed spawns or drop chances. Lumber nodes remain dynamic.
Obsidian Cobraskin and other elusive rare skins have lockout/cooldown and chance limits. Player reports disagree on timing and drop rates; no fixed rate is encoded.
Snowball is a Classic seasonal farmable input needed by a Dragonflight novelty recipe, not a Dragonflight-world drop.
Three housing products have patch-12.1.5 source-index markers and verified Retail item/creating-spell/reagent data; recipe learning and in-game availability were not exercised.
Fourteen bound records are clearly labeled support inputs: Dragonpine Lumber, four elemental souls and nine Forbidden Reach curio ingredients. They are not AH products.

The initial 241 item/guide pages were readable; 143 later ingredient-page requests returned HTTP 403. Missing page content was not treated as verified. Binding/reagent checks used readable Retail tooltips; batch/identity checks used public client-data tables, with web results for vendor-only supplies.
The minimal data-spec harness is a fallback, not Busted. Its same nine baseline failures remain unrelated to the new Dragonflight tests.
